strategy.name: Uber bounded baseline allocation
strategy.thesis: Uber's scaled demand, dispatch, payments, delivery, advertising and membership network supports cash generation and may distribute autonomous supply; the current plan's full-baseline economics justify bounded long-equity exposure because medium confidence, autonomy disintermediation, insurance, regulation, incentives, dilution and insufficient diversification prevent conviction treatment.
strategy.entry_rule: Open only while allocation_plan_4e0ef8323f8d383f6b85, allocation_intent_ae3d5bc9b6efe4a816f1, assessment_7fe1690682aa6c66e233 and relationship_d403f81ae5b27c9643dd remain current, fresh UBER USD and USD/EUR inputs are available, and deterministic code derives a positive whole-share delta toward the persisted five-share target after holdings and pending orders.
strategy.exit_rule: Reduce or close only when a current deterministic allocation plan directs reduce or close, the full-baseline eligibility frontier no longer clears, a hard blocker appears, or material autonomy, insurance, regulatory, operating or valuation evidence invalidates the bounded thesis.
strategy.invalidation: Do not increase exposure if autonomous fleets bypass Uber, trip or bookings growth stops producing free cash flow, insurance or regulation structurally compresses marketplace economics, incentives or dilution absorb value, the assessment or relationship is superseded, or market or FX inputs become stale.
